name: Dongfang gas fields, South China Sea
description: Mammoet performed 18,000 t topside load-out at Zhuhai yard and float-over transportation onto an offshore jacket; used 4 x 850 t strand jacks, 4 x 2,400 t ballast pumps, 12 x 1,000 t de-ballast pumps; field 132 km west of Dongfang City, expected up to 43,000 boepd.
